name: 几何规则
description: 线段穿矩形、路径交叉、容器内外连接等几何约束

rules.name: 路径穿透检测
rules.detect: function(eventType, payload) { return eventType === 'geometry-fail' && payload.error && payload.error.includes('穿透'); }
rules.analyze: function(payload) { return { rootCause: '线段穿越了不应经过的矩形区域', impact: '视觉混乱，违反规范 §2.3.2', suggestedFix: '调整路径路由，绕行或走容器外侧', severity: 'high' }; }

rules.name: 折线正交化
rules.detect: function(eventType, payload) { return eventType === 'lint-fail' && payload.error && payload.error.includes('折线'); }
rules.analyze: function(payload) { return { rootCause: '路径未使用正交折线（水平+垂直）', impact: '不符合线型规范', suggestedFix: '改为 L 型或 Z 型正交折线', severity: 'medium' }; }

rules.name: 容器内不连线
rules.detect: function(eventType, payload) { return eventType === 'geometry-fail' && payload.error && payload.error.includes('容器内'); }
rules.analyze: function(payload) { return { rootCause: '线段起点在容器内部', impact: '违反 §2.4.5 容器内不连线', suggestedFix: '起点移至容器外 6px', severity: 'high' }; }
